quote.text: A paused ad account and an uncontacted lead list aren't bad luck. They're a to-do list you've been avoiding.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No prospect replies and no money or security flags in the inbox over the last 48 hours, so this is a pure execution day. Clear the blocker first: the latest Facebook Ads pull (Jun 28) still shows the Lead Gen campaign PAUSED with both ads at CAMPAIGN_PAUSED, which means your only paid lead source has been dark. Unpause and confirm delivery before the 8 AM refresh, then spend the day on personal follow-up to the 27+ unbooked GHL leads and manual outbound. Do not buy new leads while old ones sit uncontacted.
focus: The latest ads pull (Jun 28) still shows the Lead Gen campaign PAUSED with both ads at CAMPAIGN_PAUSED at a $35/day budget. Open Ads Manager and confirm it's live before the 8 AM refresh — while it's dark your only paid lead source produces nothing and the funnel runs dry today.

27+ leads at ~$17 CPL and still zero closed means the gap is follow-up, not lead flow. Run a personal call-and-text pass on every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link, starting with anyone who opted in this week.

Inbox has zero prospects, so today is an outbound day. Confirm the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 FB groups, then manually DM 10 home-service businesses to build pipeline that doesn't depend on the paused ad account.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations in the last 48 hours, and nothing financial or security-related that needs action. The inbox is all noise: NYT crossword newsletters, routine Bank of America Zelle and statement alerts, Poshmark order and offer notifications, a Capital One scheduled-payment notice, and a ClearViewMA telehealth forms reminder (personal, not Novaro). No prospect email action needed; today's work is unpausing the ad campaign, lead follow-up, and outbound.
